title: Keep cache verification within its timeout and isolate cache-budget mutations from the shared install

source.ref: Frequency comprehensive audit, 2026-10-22; serial cache census and cache-budget tests exceeded the existing 30-second test timeout

detail: The cache census repeatedly read and stripped every source file for each table query; snapshot its read-only source once per file within this test suite, preserving comment/import blanking and every ownership/invalidation assertion. The cache-budget mutation suite measured the shared repository install, and non-warn variants could reach its pnpm orphan pruner. Run the unmodified control and real-script mutants against a temporary measured 12 MiB sparse-file install, copy the actual orphan scanner, assert the floor diagnostic, bound child runtime, and clean fixtures after each test. No production budget, timeout, runtime code or application behavior changed. Previous serial run: cache census 294 seconds and budget suite 62 seconds, with four timeouts. Fixed cache suites: 27 tests passed in 6.11 seconds; subsequent expanded run: 88 tests passed across eight suites in 8.07 seconds. This is local test verification, not a production speed measurement. Full follow-up including the earlier SEO/AI-search failures, commerce checkout, CRM enrichment and recovery: 404 tests across 27 suites passed in 26.78 seconds. Probe-cost correction on 2026-10-23: the prior ledger command reran the full test runner (node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --cache=false --fsModuleCachePath .next/cache/audit-vitest --maxWorkers=1 lib/cross-request-cache.test.ts scripts/check-cache-budget-warn-only.test.ts). Keep those comprehensive behavior tests in normal CI; the ledger now executes the actual code/fixture consequence directly without a nested runner. No assertion or application gate is waived.

verify.note: Runs unchanged census and mutation assertions under the existing test timeout; each mutant measures a disposable tree and the non-warn breach control must fail. Normal CI retains the fuller test suites; this direct probe keeps the per-row guard bounded.
